# Methods
Peptide-level data were exported as a BGS Factory Report from Spectronaut Viewer, version 20.4.260109.92449, using default settings. 

The Bioconductor package limpa [1, 2], version `r sessionInfo()$otherPkgs$limpa$Version` was used to quantify data at the protein level and conduct differential expression analyses.  The differential expression models included condition (healthy vs. OA), joint, the condition-joint interaction, age, sex, breed, and proteomics batch.  Analyses were conducted using `r sessionInfo()$R.version$version.string` [3].

1. Li M, Cobbold SA, Smyth GK (2025). “Quantification and differential analysis of mass spectrometry proteomics data with probabilistic recovery of information from missing values.” bioRxiv, April 29, 651125. doi:10.1101/2025.04.28.651125.

2. Li M, Smyth GK (2023). “Neither random nor censored: estimating intensity-dependent probabilities for missing values in label-free proteomics.” Bioinformatics, 39(5), btad200. doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btad200.

3. R Core Team (2025). _R: A Language and Environment for Statistical Computing_. R Foundation for Statistical Computing, Vienna, Austria. <https://www.R-project.org/>.

```{r}
file.use <- "20260206_134557_SpN_Reesink_120EqCabalLaminSyFl_iun25_Report.tsv"
pdata.file <- "2026.02.05 Peralta AAEP Metadata_combined v2.xlsx"
```

> **Input files:** Place the Spectronaut TSV report and metadata workbook in the
> working directory before knitting. These source data are not included in this
> repository; see `README.md` for details.

Peptide data were read from the file `r file.use` and sample information was read from the file `r pdata.file`.

```{r, include = FALSE}
# read in metadata
pdata <- as.data.frame(read_excel(pdata.file))
pdata$Joint <- ifelse(pdata$Joint == "Feltock", "Fetlock", pdata$Joint)
pdata$`Proteomics Batch` <- factor(pdata$`Proteomics Batch`)
pdata$Group <- interaction(pdata$`Healthy vs OA`, pdata$Fluid)

# Subset to fetlock and carpus samples
pdata <- subset(pdata, Fluid != "Plasma")
```

Only fetlock and carpus samples were included in this analysis.

```{r, include = FALSE}
y.peptide <- readSpectronaut(file = file.use, run.column = "R.FileName", extra.columns = c("PG.ProteinAccessions", "PG.ProteinDescriptions"), q.cutoffs = rep(0.01, 2))

# Subset to fetlock and carpus samples
sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(y.peptide), split = "_"), `[`, 4)
colnames(y.peptide) <- sample.names
y.peptide <- y.peptide[,as.character(pdata$`Proteomics Tube #`)]
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
y.peptide <- filterCompoundProteins(y.peptide, protein.group = "PG.ProteinAccessions")
y.peptide <- filterSingletonPeptides(y.peptide, min.n.peptides = 2, protein.group = "PG.ProteinAccessions")
dpcfit <- dpc(y.peptide)
y.protein <- dpcQuant(y.peptide, "PG.ProteinAccessions", dpc = dpcfit)
```

```{r}
drop <- grep("Cont_", rownames(y.protein))
y.protein <- y.protein[-drop,]
```

# Results
After removing contaminant proteins, `r nrow(y.protein)` proteins were present in the data.


## Boxplots of protein profiles by group
Each box is a sample
```{r, fig.height = 6, dpi = 300}
boxplot(y.protein$E, col = as.numeric(factor(pdata$Group)) + 1)
legend("topleft", legend = levels(factor(pdata$Group)), fill = 2:5, cex = 0.5, horiz = TRUE)
```

## Multidimensional scaling plots
Multidimensional scaling (MDS) plots are a two dimensional representation of the relative distances between protein profiles from each sample.

```{r}
coords <- plotMDSUsingSEs(y.protein, plot = FALSE)
plotdat <- pdata
plotdat$`MDS dim 1` <- coords$x
plotdat$`MDS dim 2` <- coords$y
```

#### MDS plot by healthy/OA and joint
```{r}
ggplot(

    aes(
        x = `MDS dim 1`,
        y = `MDS dim 2`,
        color = `Healthy vs OA`
```

## Differential expression
Output includes the following columns:

* NPeptides: Number of peptides 

* PropObs: Average proportion of peptides detected

* logFC: log2 fold change, with the group listed first in the comparison or file name being the numerator of the fold change

* t: t statistic, i.e. log fold change divided by its standard error

* P.Value: Raw p-value for the test that the log fold change differs from 0

* adj.P.Val: Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate adjusted p-value

```{r, include = FALSE}
design <- model.matrix(~`Healthy vs OA`*Joint + `Age (years)` + Sex + `Breed 2` + `Proteomics Batch`, data = pdata)
fit <- dpcDE(y.protein, design, plot = FALSE)
fit <- eBayes(fit)
```

```{r}
fit_by_fluid <- function(fluid.name) {
  keep <- pdata$Fluid == fluid.name
  pdata.sub <- pdata[keep, ]
  y.protein.sub <- y.protein[, keep]

  design.sub <- model.matrix(~`Healthy vs OA` + `Age (years)` + Sex + `Breed 2`,
                              data = pdata.sub)
  fit.sub <- dpcDE(y.protein.sub, design.sub, plot = FALSE)
  fit.sub <- eBayes(fit.sub)

  tab.sub <- topTable(fit.sub, coef = 2, n = Inf)
  tab.sub$PG.ProteinAccessions <- rownames(tab.sub)
  tab.sub
}

df_carpus  <- fit_by_fluid("Carpal")
df_fetlock <- fit_by_fluid("Fetlock")
df_plasma  <- fit_by_fluid("Plasma")
```

```{r}
dir.create("carpus_plasma_boxplots_svg",showWarnings=FALSE)

proteins.use <- c("F7DMX6","F7DNT0","A0A3Q2HWB5","A0A3Q2H908")

get_label <- function(prot) {
  for (df in list(df_carpus,df_plasma)) {
    idx <- match(prot,df$PG.ProteinAccessions)
    if (!is.na(idx)) return(df$PG.ProteinDescriptions[idx])
  }
  prot
}
labels <- sapply(proteins.use,get_label)
names(labels) <- proteins.use

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (length(p)==0 || is.na(p)) return("ns")
  if (p<0.001) "****" else if (p<0.01) "***" else if (p<0.05) "**" else if (p<0.1) "*" else "ns"
}

get_pval <- function(df,prot) {
  idx <- match(prot,df$PG.ProteinAccessions)
  if (is.na(idx)) NA_real_ else df$P.Value[idx]
}

fluid.levels <- c("Carpal","Plasma")
dodge.w <- 0.7
half <- dodge.w/4
plots <- list()

for (prot in proteins.use) {
  keep <- pdata$Fluid %in% fluid.levels
  plotdat <- pdata[keep,]
  plotdat$y <- as.numeric(y.protein$E[prot,keep])
  plotdat$Fluid <- factor(plotdat$Fluid,levels=fluid.levels)

  sig.carpus <- p_to_stars(get_pval(df_carpus,prot))
  sig.plasma <- p_to_stars(get_pval(df_plasma,prot))

  y.range <- diff(range(plotdat$y,na.rm=TRUE))
  y.pos <- max(plotdat$y,na.rm=TRUE)+0.08*y.range
  tick <- 0.02*y.range
  x.center <- seq_along(fluid.levels)
  sig.labels <- c(sig.carpus,sig.plasma)

  bracket.df <- data.frame(x=x.center-half,xend=x.center+half,y=y.pos,yend=y.pos)
  tickL.df <- data.frame(x=x.center-half,xend=x.center-half,y=y.pos,yend=y.pos-tick)
  tickR.df <- data.frame(x=x.center+half,xend=x.center+half,y=y.pos,yend=y.pos-tick)
  label.df <- data.frame(x=x.center,y=y.pos+tick,label=sig.labels)

  p <- ggplot(plotdat,aes(x=Fluid,y=y,fill=`Healthy vs OA`)) +
    geom_boxplot(width=0.6,position=position_dodge(width=dodge.w)) +
    geom_segment(data=bracket.df,aes(x=x,xend=xend,y=y,yend=yend),inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data=tickL.df,aes(x=x,xend=xend,y=y,yend=yend),inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data=tickR.df,aes(x=x,xend=xend,y=y,yend=yend),inherit.aes=FALSE) +
    geom_text(data=label.df,aes(x=x,y=y,label=label),inherit.aes=FALSE,size=6) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=c(0.05,0.15))) +
    labs(x=NULL,y="log2 Normalized Expression",title=labels[prot],fill=NULL) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold",size=22),
          axis.title.x=element_text(size=19),axis.title.y=element_text(size=19),
          axis.text.x=element_text(size=17),axis.text.y=element_text(size=17),
          panel.grid.major=element_blank(),panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
          legend.text=element_text(size=19),legend.title=element_text(size=19),
          legend.key.size=unit(1.2,"cm")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("Healthy"="#0072B5","OA"="#BC3C29"))+
    scale_x_discrete(labels=c("Carpal"="Carpus","Plasma"="Plasma"))

  plots[[prot]] <- p
  print(p)
  ggsave(paste0("carpus_plasma_boxplots_svg/",prot,".svg"),plot=p,device="svg",width=8,height=6)
}
```

```{r}
dir.create("carpus_only_boxplots_svg",showWarnings=FALSE)

proteins.use <- c("F7DMX6","F7DNT0","A0A3Q2HWB5","A0A3Q2H908")

get_label <- function(prot) {

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (length(p)==0 || is.na(p)) return("ns")
  if (p<0.001) "****" else if (p<0.01) "***" else if (p<0.05) "**" else if (p<0.1) "*" else "ns"
```

```{r}
dir.create("all_fluids_boxplots_svg", showWarnings = FALSE)

proteins.use <- c("F7DMX6", "F7DNT0", "A0A3Q2HWB5", "A0A3Q2H908")

# tab.all doesn't exist yet -- build labels from whichever fluid-specific table has the protein
get_label <- function(prot) {
  for (df in list(df_fetlock, df_carpus, df_plasma)) {
    idx <- match(prot, df$PG.ProteinAccessions)
    if (!is.na(idx)) return(df$PG.ProteinDescriptions[idx])
  }
  prot
}
labels <- sapply(proteins.use, get_label)
names(labels) <- proteins.use

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p)) return("ns")
  if (p < 0.001) "****"
  else if (p < 0.01) "***"
  else if (p < 0.05) "**"
  else if (p < 0.1) "*"
  else "ns"
}

get_pval <- function(df, prot) {
  idx <- match(prot, df$PG.ProteinAccessions)
  if (is.na(idx)) NA_real_ else df$P.Value[idx]
}

fluid.levels <- c("Fetlock", "Carpal", "Plasma")
dodge.w <- 0.7
half <- dodge.w / 4
plots <- list()

for (prot in proteins.use) {
  plotdat <- pdata
  plotdat$y <- as.numeric(y.protein$E[prot, ])
  plotdat$Fluid <- factor(plotdat$Fluid, levels = fluid.levels)

  sig.fetlock <- p_to_stars(get_pval(df_fetlock, prot))
  sig.carpus  <- p_to_stars(get_pval(df_carpus,  prot))
  sig.plasma  <- p_to_stars(get_pval(df_plasma,  prot))

  y.range <- diff(range(plotdat$y, na.rm = TRUE))
  y.pos <- max(plotdat$y, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.08 * y.range
  tick <- 0.02 * y.range

  x.center <- seq_along(fluid.levels)   # Fetlock=1, Carpal=2, Plasma=3
  sig.labels <- c(sig.fetlock, sig.carpus, sig.plasma)  # matches fluid.levels order

  bracket.df <- data.frame(x = x.center - half, xend = x.center + half, y = y.pos, yend = y.pos)
  tickL.df   <- data.frame(x = x.center - half, xend = x.center - half, y = y.pos, yend = y.pos - tick)
  tickR.df   <- data.frame(x = x.center + half, xend = x.center + half, y = y.pos, yend = y.pos - tick)
  label.df   <- data.frame(x = x.center, y = y.pos + tick, label = sig.labels)

  p <- ggplot(plotdat, aes(x = Fluid, y = y, fill = `Healthy vs OA`)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = dodge.w)) +
    geom_segment(data = bracket.df, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data = tickL.df, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_segment(data = tickR.df, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = label.df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 Normalized Expression", title = labels[prot], fill = NULL) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 17),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 17),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 19),      # legend text size
      legend.title = element_text(size = 19),     # legend title size (if you have one)
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm")           # size of the colored key/icon box
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "#0072B5", "OA" = "#BC3C29"))

  plots[[prot]] <- p
  print(p)
  ggsave(paste0("all_fluids_boxplots_svg/", prot, ".svg"), plot = p, device = "svg", width = 8, height = 6)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggsignif)

dir.create("carpus_boxplots_svg", showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- specify your proteins manually here ---
proteins.use <- c("F7DMX6", "F7DNT0", "A0A3Q2HWB5", "P68255")  # <-- your accessions

# sanity check they exist in tab0 / y.protein
stopifnot(all(proteins.use %in% tab0$PG.ProteinAccessions))
stopifnot(all(proteins.use %in% rownames(y.protein$E)))

labels <- tab0$PG.ProteinDescriptions[match(proteins.use, tab0$PG.ProteinAccessions)]
names(labels) <- proteins.use

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("ns")
  if (p < 0.0001) "****"
  else if (p < 0.001) "***"
  else if (p < 0.01) "**"
  else if (p < 0.05) "*"
  else "ns"
}

tmp <- sapply(proteins.use, function(prot){
  plotdat <- pdata
  keep <- plotdat$Joint == "Carpus"
  plotdat <- plotdat[keep, ]

  plotdat$y <- as.numeric(y.protein$E[prot, keep])

  p.val <- tab0$adj.P.Val[tab0$PG.ProteinAccessions == prot]
  sig.label <- p_to_stars(p.val)

  y.pos <- max(plotdat$y, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1 * diff(range(plotdat$y, na.rm = TRUE))

  p <- ggplot(plotdat, aes(x = `Healthy vs OA`, y = y, fill = `Healthy vs OA`)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.3) +
    geom_signif(
      comparisons = list(c("Healthy", "OA")),
      annotations = sig.label,
      y_position = y.pos,
      tip_length = 0.02,
      textsize = 8
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 Normalized Expression", title = labels[prot], fill = NULL) +
    theme_linedraw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 17),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 17),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Healthy" = "#0072B5", "OA" = "#BC3C29"))

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("carpus_boxplots_svg/", prot, ".svg"),
    plot = p,
    device = "svg",
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
})
```

## Paired synovial fluid and plasma comparison

The following section reloads the metadata and peptide-level data to perform the paired-fluid comparison.

```{r}
# Read metadata
pdata <- as.data.frame(read_excel(pdata.file))

pdata$Joint <- ifelse(pdata$Joint == "Feltock", "Fetlock", pdata$Joint)
pdata$`Proteomics Batch` <- factor(pdata$`Proteomics Batch`)

# keep only fetlock and plasma, remove carpus
pdata2 <- subset(pdata, Fluid != "Carpal")

pdata2$Group <- interaction(pdata2$`Healthy vs OA`, pdata2$Fluid)

```

```{r}
# read peptide data
y.peptide <- readSpectronaut(
  file = file.use,
  run.column = "R.FileName",
  extra.columns = c("PG.ProteinAccessions", "PG.ProteinDescriptions"),
  q.cutoffs = rep(0.01, 2)
)

sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(y.peptide), "_"), `[`, 4)
colnames(y.peptide) <- sample.names

# align to filtered metadata
y.peptide <- y.peptide[, as.character(pdata2$`Proteomics Tube #`)]
```


```{r}
y.peptide <- filterCompoundProteins(y.peptide, protein.group = "PG.ProteinAccessions")
y.peptide <- filterSingletonPeptides(y.peptide, min.n.peptides = 2, protein.group = "PG.ProteinAccessions")

dpcfit <- dpc(y.peptide)
y.protein <- dpcQuant(y.peptide, "PG.ProteinAccessions", dpc = dpcfit)
```

```{r}
drop <- grep("Cont_", rownames(y.protein))
y.protein <- y.protein[-drop, ]
```

```{r}
coords <- plotMDSUsingSEs(y.protein, plot = FALSE)

plotdat <- pdata2
plotdat$mds1 <- coords$x
plotdat$mds2 <- coords$y
```

```{r}
plotdat <- plotdat %>%
  group_by(MRN) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Fluid) == 2) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
line_data <- plotdat %>%
  select(MRN, Fluid, mds1, mds2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Fluid,
    values_from = c(mds1, mds2)
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot() +

  geom_segment(
    data = line_data,
    aes(x = mds1_Fetlock, y = mds2_Fetlock,
        xend = mds1_Plasma, yend = mds2_Plasma,
        group = MRN),
    color = "grey70"
  ) +

  stat_ellipse(
    data = plotdat,
    aes(x = mds1, y = mds2,
        color = Fluid,
        group = Fluid, fill = Fluid),
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.2,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = plotdat,
    aes(x = mds1, y = mds2,
        shape = `Healthy vs OA`, fill = Fluid),
    color = "black",
    size = 3.5
  ) +

  theme_linedraw() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 30),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 24),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Fetlock" = "forestgreen", "Plasma" = "violetred3")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fetlock" = "forestgreen", "Plasma" = "violetred3")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Healthy"= 21, 'OA' = 24)) +
  guides(
  fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      shape = 21,
      color = NA
    )
  ),
  shape = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      fill = "black"
    )
  )
) +
  labs(title = "Paired Synovial Fluid & Plasma", x= "MDS dim 1", y = "MDS dim 2")
ggsave("paired_mds.svg", width = 8, height = 6, device = "svg")
```
